subject: Orientation guide?
text:
Hi,

Quick thing, maybe badly timed, but I wanted to ask before I lose the note. Did you still have the volunteer orientation guide we used last fall? I started to gather it for Saturday, then the team moved our priorities around and the food bank visit became the main event, so I realized I need the document again.

It is a bit scattered in my files, and I cannot find whether I saved the final version or just screenshots. If you have it, even an older copy, that would help. I can edit around the old dates. No pressure if it is gone. It would save me a lot of back and forth today.
